$comment: Exact pin of the finplan-contracts package consumed by FinanceModel (task 1.2, contracts CS-04 consumer case). The digest is the SHA-256 of the exact vendored wheel (also recorded in uv.lock, which uv verifies on install). 1.1.0 (research universe, daily_recommendation job kind, production-strategy document, bias_disclosures) is a stable 1.x release: it is allowed in beta, gamma and prod. The wheel is the FinancialPlanning platform's reproducible build (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=315532800), vendored byte for byte; the FinancialPlanning build stage publishes the same bytes to the CodeArtifact registry (/finplan/shared/financialplanning/contract/registry-ref) once its bootstrap is re-run, and refuses to publish different bytes under the same version.
source: FinancialPlanning platform vendored wheel (built from its contracts/python; the same artifact its build stage publishes to CodeArtifact)
registry: CodeArtifact via /finplan/shared/financialplanning/contract/registry-ref (domain finplan, repository contracts); available after the FinancialPlanning bootstrap re-run and its next build
